subject: external: range job keys and region split keys are 2 concepts (part 1) (#55659)
summary: Separates global-sort external-engine boundaries into `rangeJobKeys` (for range jobs) vs `regionSplitKeys` (for region splitting): `external.RangeSplitter` now returns both; DDL/importinto task metas carry both; executors keep backward-compat by falling back to legacy `RangeSplitKeys` when `RangeJobKeys` is absent. Reviewed DDL scheduler/executor wiring and splitter semantics for correctness/consistency/compatibility/state handling; no remaining Blocker/High issues found.
